title: StopCondition
description: The budget and halt rules an agent declares before an autonomous loop, a retry series, or a long unattended run. Declared before the first retry, not after the budget is spent. Backs rule X-stop-conditions and eval E31; the run-budget rules live in references/tool-discipline.md. Enforces Principle 5.

turns.description: Maximum tool calls or loop iterations.

attempts.description: Maximum attempts at the same goal (a retry series).

cost.description: Spend ceiling in the account's currency (tokens, dollars, API credits).

budget.description: At least one bound. The loop stops when any bound is reached.

success_check.description: The machine-runnable condition that means done (a command and its expected output, a file state, a status value). Never the agent's own opinion.

abort_check.description: The condition that stops the loop early: the same error class twice, no progress between iterations, a state drift, a gate denial.

on_exhaustion.description: What happens when the budget runs out without success: report the attempts, the distinct errors, the last state, and a next step that is not 'keep retrying'.

status_every.description: When a status line is emitted (each quarter of the budget by default).

declared_at.description: When the condition was declared, relative to the run: 'before first attempt' or a timestamp. A budget declared after it was reached is retro-fitted.
